We present DVAE 1, a model based reinforcement algorithm that is more sample efficient than model free algorithms in simulated environments.

improving model based reinforcement learning for real world environments.
improving sample efficiency in reinforcement learning, with the goal of making deep reinforcement learning more viable for real world applications in the warehouse industry.
the question how can we make reinforcement learning algorithms sample efficient in industry near environments.

DVAE2 is a promising approach for model based reinforcement learning in the warehouse industry.

we present a novel model based reinforcement learning approach for warehouse operations and show its potential for real world applications.

model based reinforcement learning is a viable option for industry near environments.
